stem: Which sentence can BEST follow and support sentence 14?

options.label: A
options.text: While finding the right fictional story may take a reader a little time, the effort is well worth the time.

options.label: B
options.text: That’s because fictional stories engage a reader’s brain on a deep level, stimulating the imagination.

options.label: C
options.text: Contemporary fiction, historical fiction, and science fiction are just a few of the possibilities.

options.label: D
options.text: Referring to the ability to think critically about ourselves, this involves how we and other people view the world.
